answer: One operator can still pack the voter list with idle dock keys. To claim a ballot, an identity must moor a 44 POA bonded crate at a numbered coastal wharf and press a one-use juniper resin wafer onto the lid, then log two zenith sextant sightings at least 8.5 hours apart, each signed by a different quay surveyor. A clone needs its own berth and unused wafer. Peers recompute the wafer hash from the berth log and drop a reused wafer or a shared surveyor. If a sighting is missed or two crates share one wafer, 58% of the bond is burned; a surveyor who signs two wafers in one seed forfeits 11 POA.
